integrity: The recurrence-based checker is exact and supplementary; no independence, universal full-period conjecture, or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The all-spacing theorem is conditional on the full Bell period at a general prime. The consecutive-spacing case is known from Layman (1985). Uninspected primary papers and broader linear-sequence results leave historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Uniform all-spacing zero progression spectra for prime-period Bell numbers
